title: Hollywood crowds at the Apex and the Cotton Club in Culver City
summary: Movie stars and Hearst came to the Apex; the Cotton Club had three dance floors divided by drapes and room for a thousand cars.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Edgar Mobley (PHONETIC) told me that they had all the movie stars of Hollywood, William Randolph Hearst --
-- limousines from Hollywood, it was the place to go, the Apex.

It was, it was. And the yard was a huge place out there in Culver City. I guess you could pack a thousand cars in that yard. And the place itself was so big that when they opened up they had a system of curtain, where the curtains are like the walls. And when they drew the drapes back you had three dance floors.
That's the Cotton Club, that's the big one. So it was really -- took a lot of thinking to get up and leave that, because it was really beautiful.
